hook: Every spot on the island is a complex number. Adding walks you a fixed step, times i swings you a quarter turn around the harbor, and squaring sends you spiraling out to sea.
outcome: Add, multiply and conjugate complex numbers, see multiplication as turning and stretching on the complex plane, and locate the complex solutions of a quadratic
sources: OpenStax, College Algebra 2e, 2.4 Complex Numbers (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/2-4-complex-numbers
OpenStax, College Algebra 2e, 2.5 Quadratic Equations (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/2-5-quadratic-equations
OpenStax, Precalculus 2e, 8.5 Polar Form of Complex Numbers (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/8-5-polar-form-of-complex-numbers
Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, High School Number and Quantity (N-CN): https://www.thecorestandards.org/Math/Content/HSN/CN/
Landmark values, clues and presets are arithmetic, checked in the tool (2026-10-25)
Coastline, sea, landmark icons, markers and graph drawn in code; island terrain texture painted locally (no people), clipped to the coast; sounds generated in the browser
